surface_before_placement.rule: STOP at Spearman > 0.9 or directed <= 3 px dot proximity > 0.7; probes classified by measured coverage >= 0.95
surface_before_placement.scope: Supplied aligned immutable public inventory only; private/release/unlinked artifacts are not proven absent.

final_dots.rule: STOP at Spearman > 0.9 or directed <= 3 px dot proximity > 0.7; probes classified by measured coverage >= 0.95
final_dots.scope: Supplied aligned immutable public inventory only; private/release/unlinked artifacts are not proven absent.

note: Literal verdict applies the lane rule to every prior, probes included; policy verdict excludes universal-coverage probes (see gates.lane_report docstring). A literal DUPLICATE on a registry that contains universal-coverage probes is a registry property, not a candidate property.
